description: Greek cooking centers on oregano and lemon, rice, and olive oil. Olive oil, acid, and herbs carry the plate — meat is often a flavoring, not the bulk.

attributes.micro_lesson: Layer olive oil, garlic, lemon, and herbs; char vegetables for smoke without heaviness.
attributes.shopping_tip: Quality olive oil, lemons, olives, and dried oregano transform simple ingredients.
flavor_building: Start with olive oil as your cooking medium.
Season with oregano and lemon — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Greek food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
